# A run that rests almost entirely on one party

*standard · 7 angles · 7 sources*

## Executive Summary

Nearly everything here comes from the vendor's own estate [1][7].

## Introduction

Scope. Seven angles were worked, and six of the seven landed on the same party.

## Findings

### Finding 1: The picture is largely the vendor's account of itself

**Confidence: Weak** - every source but one is the vendor describing its own product.

The documentation sets out the route [1], the pricing page states the tiers [2],
the changelog dates the release [3], the reference covers the limits [4], the
announcement describes the rollout [5] and the guide explains the migration [6].
One independent thread describes what practitioners actually did [7].

## Synthesis

A single party dominates the evidence.

## Limitations

The concentration is the finding.

## Recommendations

Find a second party before acting on this.
